app.palette: Type a command or search items…
nav.drop_folder: Drop a folder here to open it as a project
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.verify.hint: An agent says these are finished. Mark them done, or send them back.
inbox.unassigned_one: {n} item isn’t in a project yet
inbox.unassigned_other: {n} items aren’t in a project yet
list.no_uv: uv isn’t installed, so Blurt can’t read or change items yet.
detail.pick: Select an item to see it here
project.header.worktree: Use a worktree for agent sessions
project.header.not_git: Not a git repository: agents work in the folder itself
project.inbox.lead: Items Blurt couldn’t place in a project. Drag them onto one, or open them to pick.
act.copied: Copied — paste it into your agent
dispatch.mode.together.hint: One session works through all of them
dispatch.mode.parallel.hint: One session per item, each in its own worktree
dispatch.worktree.hint: A separate checkout and branch: review the diff, then merge, open a PR or discard
dispatch.worktree.off_hint: The agent edits the project folder directly
dispatch.no_agents: No agent can run a session yet. Install Claude Code or Codex and sign in.
dispatch.warn.concurrent_edit: Another session is already changing files in {project}. Editing the same files at the same time can cause conflicts — a worktree keeps them apart.
dispatch.warn.no_git: {project} isn’t a git repository, so the sessions share the folder.
dispatch.warn.no_tmux: tmux isn’t installed: the session runs inside Blurt and ends when you quit it.
dispatch.warn.draft_confirmed: Items still waiting for review are kept when you hand them over.
dispatch.needs_project: These items aren’t in a project folder yet — move them to one first.
dispatch.copy: Or copy it for your own agent
sessions.title: Agent Sessions
sessions.empty.title: No sessions yet
sessions.empty.body: Select items and choose Hand to Agent. Claude Code or Codex works on them here, in a terminal you can take over at any time.
sessions.app_runner: Runs inside Blurt: quitting Blurt ends this session.
sessions.detached: Keeps running when you close Blurt.
sessions.diff.title: {n} files changed
sessions.merged: Merged — the items are ready to verify
sessions.pick: Select a session to see its terminal
error.no_agent: No coding agent is ready — set one up in Settings → Agents.
error.needs_project: Move these items to a project folder first.
error.conflict: The merge has conflicts; nothing was changed. Resolve it in the worktree, or open a pull request.
error.dirty: Your project folder has uncommitted changes; commit or stash them, then merge.
error.mixed_projects: These items are in different projects — hand them over one project at a time.
error.deleted: Dropped items can’t be handed over.
error.bad_transition: Some of these items are already being worked on or done.
error.bad_agent: That agent can’t run a session.
error.no_worktree: This session didn’t use a worktree.
error.uncommitted: The worktree has uncommitted changes — ask the agent to commit them first.
error.wrong_branch: Your project folder is on another branch; switch back to the base branch to merge.
error.nothing: The branch has no new commits.
error.no_remote: The project has no remote to push to.
settings.notify.agent: Notify when an agent needs you
settings.notify.hint: Only while Blurt isn’t in front, and never with sound.
settings.tmux.missing: Not installed — sessions run inside Blurt instead
settings.tmux.ok: Sessions keep running after you close Blurt
settings.dmabuf: Disable WebKit DMA-BUF rendering (fixes a black window on NVIDIA)
settings.restart: Takes effect after you restart Blurt
settings.updates.none: Updates aren’t set up in this build
settings.hotkey.help: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Backspace turns it off, Esc cancels.
settings.hotkey.taken: Couldn’t register it — another app probably uses it
settings.hotkey.invalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or {super} with a key (function keys can stand alone)
settings.hotkey.unsupported: Not available on this system yet
settings.hotkey.manual: On Wayland, add a custom shortcut in the system settings that runs “blurt {url}”
settings.hotkey.portal_note: On Wayland, shortcuts go through the desktop’s shortcut service; change them in the system’s keyboard settings.
settings.agents.lead: Sorting captures uses the first agent here that is installed and signed in. Agent sessions let you choose.
settings.export.lead: Exports run through the Blurt skill in your agent.
